Comments: Downhill grade. Data indicates peak speed 202.6 km/h (126 mph), mean speed (half-mile) 201.2 km/h (125 mph). Mallard suffered an overheated crankpin during the run, but was repaired and returned to traffic within 9 days.
The fastest operational steam locomotive as of 2011.[citation needed]
First run at 100+ mph with complete, surviving documentation.[citation needed]
Claimed[by whom?] to be the first steam locomotive to reach100 mph (161 km/h).[citation needed]
Maximum speed claimed[by whom?], although average speed record was authenticated.[citation needed]
